decisions.statement: A record chosen is no instrumental.
A record chosen has the same normalised title as the song.
A record chosen names an artist whose normalised name has the song's.
A record with words stamped line by line wins over a record with plain words.
The first record LRCLIB answered wins where no record is stamped.
The words of a song are the body of a file beside the song's page.
The provider the words came from is a field of the song's page.

definition: an LRCLIB answer read as the words a song has
